core_obligations: Establish model-specific genus-zero spectral curve and uniform Riemann-Hilbert asymptotic expansion.
Derive the tau-function differential of the partition function and compute its leading coefficients from two subleading terms.
Integrate the exact limiting differential with the normalized t=0 boundary value to obtain the stated free-energy formula.

difficulty_reason: The exact free energy requires a complete model-specific steepest-descent construction and then a separate tau-differential calculation through two subleading spectral orders. The author integrates this differential in phase coordinates with a fixed normalization. The counted result is the partition-function limit, not the already collected X-matrix asymptotic support lemma.

dedup.scope: Root identified same-source158691 as X-asymptotics only (arxiv v3 source1977–2020), and related follow-up203735 as CD-lemma only. Targeted comparison: this task counts the explicit limiting log partition function/free-energy formula and its tau differential/integration proof; prior matrix asymptotics and CD identity are retained or cited only as support and are not counted again.

compared.difference: Prior claim is an asymptotic formula for the X Riemann-Hilbert matrix. New claim is the exact normalized genus-zero log partition-function limit obtained through additional tau differential, coefficient extraction and integration.
Related later critical-paper Christoffel-Darboux identity is not the free-energy limit theorem.
